snippet.title: Amnesia: Memories Iffy-cial Gameplay Trailer (PEGI)
snippet.description:
Check out the gameplay trailer for Amnesia: Memories! See how your choices affect your relationship parameters with your chosen bachelor, as well as how characters change personalities based on the world you've chosen, and get a glimpse also get to see the Mini-Games in action!
 
-------------------------------------------------

Amnesia: Memories, the first otome/visual novel game published by Idea Factory International for the West, is  making a simultaneous debut on both North American PSN™ and Steam on August 25! It will also be compatible with PlayStation®TV. In this visual novel, you'll play as the Heroine whose depends on hiding your recent loss of memory while you navigate complex relationships with five men. Will you be able to piece together that which was forgotten and rewrite the lasting love story you deserve, or will your love story come to an end?
